text: Core courses Inorganic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Instrument Analysis, Structural Chemistry, Chemical Engineering Foundation, Theory of Chemical Teaching, etc. Objective This objective is to train students to be high-qualified professional personnel, working in the institutions of higher learning, research institutions, middle schools, environmental protection departments or other chemistry-related sectors to teach, research or be engaged in management affairs. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.
